caption: The drawing depicts a single lidded container, likely a decorative jar or candy dish, placed against a plain beige background. The container is predominantly blue with various shades used to illustrate its three-dimensional form and reflective surface. The jar has a rounded, bulbous body adorned with a diamond or quilted pattern. It stands on a short pedestal base that flares outwards at the bottom. The lid of the container is domed and features a wavy, ridged design with a central finial at the top that is shaped like an elongated teardrop or flame, also in dark blue. The lip of the jar is slightly extended and horizontal, separating the lid from the body. The entire container exhibits a glass-like translucency, with highlights and shadows accentuating the contours and texture. The artist's signature, "H. Zaidenberg," appears in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Sugar Bowl with Cover
